annotation.evidence_span: MUST NOT be set if a timer is set
annotation.interpretation_a: If a timer for loss detection is active, the PTO timer is never started.
annotation.interpretation_b: If a timer for loss detection is active, any currently running PTO timer is stopped, but a new one may be started later.
annotation.justification: The clause states the PTO timer "MUST NOT be set" if another timer is set. This could mean that the PTO timer must never be started while the other timer is active, or that the PTO timer must be stopped if it is running when the other timer is started. Both interpretations are reasonable.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the prohibition applies only to starting a PTO timer, or also to continuing a PTO timer that was already running when the loss detection timer was started.
